justification.analysis: The gOSI-plus-permutation approach is reasonable in outline but the code is broken (undefined fold_condition/gsi) and never executed, so the phenomenon was never actually tested.
justification.correctness: No numerical results were produced at all, so nothing reproduces from the committed code.
justification.figures: The figures directory is empty; no figures were generated.
justification.honesty: No write-up or claims were produced, so nothing is misrepresented, but there is also nothing to substantiate.
